data.intent: Public, no-login encyclopedia of ultimate frisbee drills/strategies/formations/plays/skills plus full-text search & attribute filtering (PRD Features 1-2), built into the existing Vite React SPA + FastAPI/Supabase backend via a polymorphic entries schema, EncyclopediaService facade, and react-router-dom; encyclopedia owns '/', intake form relocates to /contribute.

Blocking backend root: entries/tags/entry_tags/media schema (migration 006), EncyclopediaService facade (search_entries/get_entry/get_similar) with Factory Method/Flyweight/Chain of Responsibility/Strategy patterns, and read-only /api/entries, /api/entries/{type}/{slug}, /api/search endpoints. status='published' gating enforced at the service layer.

Frontend routing scaffold: introduces react-router-dom, mounts encyclopedia shell at '/' (placeholder) and existing intake app at /contribute/*, audits intake for root-path-dependent assumptions (localStorage keys, absolute nav) and fixes any found.

data.notes_for_evaluator: All 5 acceptance criteria met: / renders placeholder (200, test + smoke), /contribute renders intake tutorial unchanged (test), submission at /contribute succeeds end-to-end (201 via dev-proxy smoke), refresh at /contribute restores localStorage draft (test), existing 18 tests pass unmodified. Backend encyclopedia foundation: 006_encyclopedia.sql (entry_type/entry_status enums, entries with generated search_vector, tags, entry_tags, media, GIN+btree indexes), EncyclopediaService facade (Factory Method entry_from_row, Flyweight TagRegistry, Chain of Responsibility 7-category filter pipeline, SortStrategy relevance/difficulty asc+desc/newest, TagOverlapStrategy get_similar) with status=published gating inside the service, and GET /api/entries, /api/entries/{type}/{slug}, /api/search thin handlers with 400/404 semantics. 50 new tests; full suite 92 passed, zero regressions.
data.canon_entry: Encyclopedia read path: browser -> /api/entries|/api/search -> EncyclopediaService (sole reader, in-service published gate, ADR-6 facade) -> EncyclopediaStore port (InMemory dev/tests, Supabase prod). Filter/sort/similarity logic is in-Python over the store port; schema ships search_vector+GIN so Postgres FTS can swap in behind the facade.
data.notes_for_evaluator: Task 3 (run migration against live Supabase) BLOCKED: .env DATABASE_URL is a placeholder and no local Postgres/Docker exists; migration validated against migrate.py statement splitter only.
